title: Owner-set per-level workflow status (mappings/mission_progress.json, committed)
description: Written only by the M4 UI on an explicit owner action. Slot-level progress is derived from manual_mappings.json and is not stored here. 'reviewed' is the owner's sign-off after the level was built and tested in MCC (step 7 of the level workflow); a tool never sets it on its own.

status.description: in_progress: matching under way. ready_for_build: every slot decided and audio approved. in_game_tested: the owner tested a build in MCC. reviewed: owner sign-off.

verification.description: Optional verifications.json entry recording the in-game test.
